newsitem.title: UK: Christian Salvesen sells U.S. storage unit.
newsitem.headline: Christian Salvesen sells U.S. storage unit.

text.p: British distribution and equipment rental group Christian Salvesen Plc said on Friday it sold its U.S. refrigerated warehousing business for 75.2 million stg.
The firm said it sold the business to a new company formed by Security Capital Industrial Trust and an affiliate of Hunt Consolidated Inc.
Christian Salvesen said about 3.7 million stg of the cash consideration could be repayable to the buyer depending on future profits.
The company said the sale was part of its strategy to refocus on its strong growth areas and added that proceeds would be used to reduce debt.
Christian Salvesen's shares rose on the deal, gaining 5.0p to 274.5 by 0810 GMT.

The operations being sold had net assets of 36.9 million stg and included Christian Salvesen Inc, Enterprise Refrigerated Services Inc, Merchants Refrigerating Co and Christian Salvesen Distribution (Canada) Ltd.
The firm was advised by SBC Warburg on the sale. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
